<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_RelatedPartyTransactionsDisclosureTextBlock', window );">Related Party Transactions Disclosure [Text Block]</a></td>
<td class="text">
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;"><b>Note <em style="font: inherit;">12</em> </b>&#8211;<b> Related Party Transactions</b> </p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">K.A.H.R. Foundation is considered a related party based on its ownership interest in the Company, its position as the sole holder of the Company&#8217;s unsecured, unquoted convertible promissory notes and related warrants issued under the Securities Purchase Agreement dated <em style="font: inherit;"> December 16, 2022, </em>and its contractual right to designate a member of the Company&#8217;s Board of Directors. See Note <em style="font: inherit;">7</em> for further details on the convertible notes and warrants. Pursuant to the Securities Purchase Agreement, K.A.H.R. Foundation has the right, for so long as the convertible notes are outstanding, to designate <em style="font: inherit;">one</em> individual to serve as a member of the Company&#8217;s Board of Directors (the &#8220;Lender Nominee&#8221;). Dr. Jeffrey Leighton has served as the Lender Nominee since <em style="font: inherit;"> July 2024.</em></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
  <span></span>
</td>

<tr><td><div class="body" style="padding: 2px;">
<a href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.toggleNext( this );">- Definition</a><div><p>The entire disclosure for related party transactions. Examples of related party transactions include transactions between (a) a parent company and its subsidiary; (b) subsidiaries of a common parent; (c) and entity and its principal owners; and (d) affiliates.</p></div>
